The Operating System module shall process all task activations on an expiry point first and then set events.

If an expiry point contains actions to activate a Task and to set one or several Event (s) of the same Task , then the Operating System module shall pro- cess this Task activation before the related Event (s) are set. No further assumptions about the order for the processing of expiry points can be made.
